This launch day Steam Deck is a mess. It freezes after five minutes and hard-shuts down as soon as you try to switch to desktop mode. The original layout had the Wi-Fi chip under the SSD which was a design flaw Valve eventually fixed because of interference and heat. Is that the problem with this one? If it is, since the APU and RAM are soldered, this unit is officially cooked unless you’re a micro-soldering pro, and even then there's no guarantee.
